true_answer: There are no such integers so g − 1 ( 3 ) | ∅ . Since f − 1 ( y ) is a set, it makes sense to ask for f − 1 ( y ) , the number of elements in the domain which map to y . Example 0.4.10 Find a function f : { 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 }→ N such that f − 1 ( 7 ) | 5 . Solution . There is only one such function. We need five elements of the domain to map to the number 7 ∈ N . Since there are only five elements in the domain, all of them must map to 7. So f | ( 1 2 3 4 5 7 7 7 7 7 ) .
